title: Enterprise Connectivity: restoration fee
content:
## Tier basis
Enterprise Connectivity uses the following restoration fee for each named contract tier. Fee for restoring a suspended holding; USD decimal.

## Tier comparison
| Contract tier | Facet | Value |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 100 Mbps | restoration fee | 0 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 250 Mbps | restoration fee | 0 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 500 Mbps | restoration fee | 0 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 1 Gbps | restoration fee | 0 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 2 Gbps | restoration fee | 0 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 5 Gbps | restoration fee | 0 |

## Basis Q&A
For the Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 100 Mbps tier, the restoration fee is 0.
